title: 🥬 perishable groceries
body:
# 🧭 Steps

1. **Fridge scan** — skip rows still in stock.
2. **Shop** the grocery list in alphabetical order.
3. **Unpack** — freeze chicken portions.
4. **Cook** — liver once; prep juice.
5. **Update prices** on the grocery list from the receipt if prices shifted.

Amounts: [ingredients.md](../../food/diet/ingredients.md) — the single source of truth — weekly need is fixed and validated. **Buy as** is the practical chunk (may overshoot). **Cadence — pick the column for your trip gap:** **½ wk** (every ~3.5 days), **Weekly** (1×), **1½ wk** (~every 10 days), **2 wk** (every 14 days). Less often than weekly = more food at once, but it keeps.

## 🛒 Shopping list

<!-- begin table -->
| Item | ½ wk | Weekly | 1½ wk | 2 wk | Unit | Buy as | Unit price | Total |
|------|------|--------|-------|------|------|--------|-----------|-------|
| Bananas | 3.5 | 7 | 10.5 | 14 | units | ~1 bunch | xx,xx | xx,xx |
| Beef (lean) | 100 | 200 | 300 | 400 | g | ~1 tray | xx,xx | xx,xx |
| Beetroot | 2.5 | 5 | 7.5 | 10 | units | ~2 bunches | xx,xx | xx,xx |
| Bovine liver | 50 | 100 | 150 | 200 | g | ~1 tray | xx,xx | xx,xx |
| Chicken breast | 300 | 600 | 900 | 1200 | g | ~1 pack | xx,xx | xx,xx |
| Eggs | 2.5 | 5 | 7.5 | 10 | units | 1 tray (10) | xx,xx | xx,xx |
| Lemon | 1.25 | 2.5 | 3.75 | 5 | units | ~1 bag | xx,xx | xx,xx |
| Pork loin | 100 | 200 | 300 | 400 | g | ~1 tray | xx,xx | xx,xx |
| Tangerines | 3.5 | 7 | 10.5 | 14 | units | ~1 bag | xx,xx | xx,xx |
| **Total** | | | | | | | | **xx,xx** |
<!-- end table -->

## 🚫 Do not buy

<!-- begin table -->
| Rule | Why |
| --- | --- |
| **No sugar** / **sugar-free treats** | Graze at home — prize instead |
| **No prize food** | Chips, ice cream, frozen pizza, bakery |
| **Grocery = fuel** | Core meat, greens, fruit, eggs |
<!-- end table -->

## ✅ Done when

- Core list bought; no sugar or prize food
- Liver scheduled; chicken portioned
